🕐 Prophecy Fulfillment Tracker
Prophecies Given — Prophecies Fulfilled — Honestly Labeled
Every prophecy listed here was written before its fulfillment. Each is labeled with an honest confidence rating — from Universal Agreement (all historians and all faith traditions agree the fulfillment occurred) to Debated (most believe it fulfilled, some scholars dispute). Only prophecies with documented historical fulfillment are included.
